Replica offers a furnished scan, so its query carries the furniture the floorplan does not model, which is the gap this method addresses. Structured3D ships no furnished mesh, so its query can only come from the same floorplan proxy as the candidates, which removes that gap and makes the acoustic side substantially easier; its rows are not comparable to Replica's on equal terms.
